'''Culsion gas''' was a rare conductive [[Gas/Legends|gas]]. [[Una Poot]] and her first husband, [[Drogue Poot|Drogue]], were attacked by [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] official who wanted to seize the cargo.<ref name="SWAJ6">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref>
